INCIDENT REPORT - CLUSTER US-EAST-4B
Timestamp: 2026-09-20T08:14:22Z | Severity: SEV-2 | Status: MITIGATED
Component: ingress-controller-envoy-v2 | Service: billing-transaction-pipeline
Description: High HTTP 504 gateway timeout rate observed following canary deployment 4.18.2.
Root Cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by misconfigured keepalive idle timeout.
Action Taken: Traffic shifted back to stable deployment 4.18.1; connection pool max_size doubled to 256.
Impact: 1,420 checkout requests failed between 08:02Z and 08:14Z. No data corruption detected.
Follow-up: Audit all service keepalive defaults and implement circuit breaker backpressure.
Telemetry snapshot: CPU utilization peaked at 78.4%, memory steady at 14.2 GB of 32 GB allocatable.
Network egress rate: 420 Mbps peak, packet drop rate 0.002% on eth0.
